app_summary: A social network with unidirectional follow relationships, implemented with loosely-coupled microservices, communicating with each other via Thrift RPCs. Supported Operations: Create text post (optional media: image, video, shortened URL, user tag), Read post, Read entire user timeline, Receive recommendations on which users to follow, Search database for user or post, Register/Login using user credentials, Follow/Unfollow user

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: The user-service deployment was scaled to 0 replicas, leaving the user-service Service with no endpoints. As a result Thrift clients (compose-post-service) attempting to connect to user-service:9090 receive "Connection refused", causing compose-post failures which propagate to nginx-thrift (ComposePost() connection refused / TTransportException).

args.root_cause: The user-service deployment was scaled to 0 replicas, leaving the user-service Service with no endpoints. As a result Thrift clients (compose-post-service) attempting to connect to user-service:9090 receive "Connection refused", causing compose-post failures which propagate to nginx-thrift (ComposePost() connection refused / TTransportException).
args.evidence_summary:
1) nginx-thrift pod logs: repeated errors at 2026/10/14 17:33:09-17:33:21 showing ComposePost(): connect() failed: Connection refused and a TTransportException (compose.lua lines 62-65).
2) compose-post-service pod logs: repeated Thrift TSocket::open() connect() <Host: user-service Port: 9090>: Connection refused and client pool failures (timestamps 2026-10-14 17:33:09 - 17:33:29).
3) kubectl get endpoints user-service returned an Endpoints object with no addresses (empty).
4) kubectl describe service user-service shows Endpoints: (empty) and TargetPort 9090.
5) kubectl describe deployment user-service shows Replicas: 0 desired | 0 updated | 0 total and Events showing it was scaled down from 1 to 0.
args.investigation_summary: I checked traces for the entrypoint (no error traces), listed pods (all Running), then inspected nginx-thrift logs which showed connection refused when composing posts. I retrieved compose-post-service logs which showed Thrift connection refused to user-service:9090. I verified the user-service Service exists but has no endpoints, and described its Deployment which revealed it has 0 replicas (was scaled down). The missing user-service pods therefore caused the connection refusals and the cascading failures.
